name: hide-files
description: Hide files matching a list of globs, and toggle them back into view from the command palette.

hideFiles.patterns.markdownDescription: Globs to hide while hiding is enabled, e.g. `**/*.lock`, `node_modules`, `**/*.{png,jpg}`. These use the same syntax as `#files.exclude#` and are matched relative to the workspace folder.

hideFiles.hiddenByDefault.markdownDescription: Whether files start out hidden the first time a workspace is opened. After that, the toggle state is remembered per workspace.

enumDescriptions: Write to the workspace's settings, so hiding only affects this workspace.
Write to your user settings, so hiding affects every workspace.
hideFiles.configurationTarget.markdownDescription: Where the generated `#files.exclude#` entries are written. Falls back to user settings when no folder is open.

hideFiles.showStatusBarItem.description: Show a status bar item indicating whether files are currently hidden.
